run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the k-th moved element in an array using single moves
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correctness of array element selection
review_f_gold: review f_gold logic for finding the best element after k non-improving moves
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the f_filled placeholder with a correct implementation
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which tracks maximum values and counts consecutive non-improving elements up to k
